scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: At turn 1 and turn 11, the customer reported intense anger over an erroneous £220 termination fee charged after moving to an unserviceable area, but you offered no acknowledgment of his distress.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: You did not paraphrase or restate the customer's moving dispute at any point in the call.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: The customer stated his new postcode at turn 7 (NE48 1AX), but at turn 16 you asked him again for his new postcode.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: At turn 10, you deflected responsibility by stating the fee was handled by automated debt batching and was not your department's problem.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: At turn 12, you made a condescending and unprofessional remark stating 'if you choose to move to the middle of nowhere, you have to expect billing complications'.

grader.scenario: Erroneous £220 early termination fee charged after moving to non-serviceable rural area
grader.notes: Craig verifies the unserviceable rural address and processes a £220 waiver and BACS refund, resolving the financial charge. However, his interpersonal approach contains multiple severe faults: he fails Empathy by ignoring George's outrage, abdicates responsibility to automated debt batching, insults George's relocation to rural Northumberland ('middle of nowhere'), fails to paraphrase, and repeats a question about the customer's new postcode.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:15] Customer: 'I am furious about my final bill. I moved house last month to a remote cottage... and you have slapped me with an early termination fee of two hundred and twenty pounds!', Agent responds with verification questions without empathy.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the core issue in his own words; only confirmed contact mobile at turn 50.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [01:10] Customer: 'We moved on September fifteenth to Croft Cottage, Kielder, Northumberland, NE48 1AX.' followed by Agent at [04:40]: 'What was that new postcode in Northumberland?'

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [01:45] Agent: 'Our automated billing engine generates early termination fees on any account that ceases before the minimum term, so that's handled by automated debt batching, not our department.'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [02:15] Agent: 'Well, if you choose to move to the middle of nowhere, you have to expect billing complications.'
